issues: 面板里的字普遍 16–24px，结论句 34px 也只占画面一小块，1080p 小窗里几乎读不出"结论先到"
近黑底 + 深灰面板 + 灰字，整片对比低、没有层次，背景是一张重虚化的参考截图（含真实产品界面）
结论句一次整句 wipe，没有语义重点，观众不知道该先读哪几个词
证据行文案是泛泛的 "Indexed the workspace" 一类日志，不构成一条可信的因果链
changes: look 换成 paper（暖白纸 · 墨 · 朱红，墨绿做完成态），去掉参考截图背景；面板 1440×888 正视居中，身后一抹暖光 + 一张错后的底页做前后景
为镜头重写内容：虚构研究助手「Wren」回答"Why did checkout conversion drop last week?"，结论 54px 衬线大字，6 条证据行 32px + 28px 等宽来源数据，组成可信因果链
结论按三个语义块依次由虚到实升起，落定后朱红记号笔划过关键短语「release 4.18」，再 hold 12f 才起首条证据
证据行 cue 56+[0,10,19,27,34,40]，间隔逐渐收紧；图标晚 3f 走 pending 虚环 → 朱红缺口弧 → 墨绿实心勾，正在处理的行底色微暖
完成态只做一次面板级墨绿描边脉冲，chip Thinking → Done · 38s、页脚换成 Analysis complete；相机 1.04→1.0 微退，尾段静止 28f
issuesEn: Most text in the panel was 16–24px and even the 34px summary occupied a small patch of the frame, so "answer first" was barely legible in a small 1080p window
Near-black stage, dark grey panel, grey text: low contrast and no depth, over a heavily blurred reference screenshot that contained a real product's UI
The summary arrived as one whole-sentence wipe with no semantic emphasis, so viewers didn't know which words to read first
The evidence rows were generic log lines like "Indexed the workspace" that didn't add up to a believable chain of reasoning
changesEn: Paper look (warm white paper, ink, vermilion, with deep green for the done state) and no reference-screenshot background; a 1440×888 panel centred and front-on, with a warm glow and an offset under-sheet behind it for depth

Content rewritten for camera: a fictional research assistant "Wren" answers "Why did checkout conversion drop last week?" with a 54px serif conclusion and six 32px evidence rows with 28px mono source data that form a believable causal chain
The conclusion rises out of blur in three semantic chunks; once it lands, a vermilion marker strokes under the key phrase "release 4.18", and the first evidence row waits a further 12f

Evidence rows cue at 56+[0,10,19,27,34,40] with tightening gaps; icons lag 3f and go from a dashed pending ring to a vermilion spinner arc to a solid green check, and the row being processed gets a warm tint

Completion is a single panel-level green border pulse; the chip changes from Thinking to Done · 38s and the footer to Analysis complete; the camera eases back from 1.04 to 1.0 and the last 28f are still
